subject: website
name: ENS Dynamic Kit
summary: ENS Dynamic Kit, a demo and docs page for an off-chain ENS resolver. The Echo-Merlini/ens-dynamic-kit repository its page links to does not exist and no other public source of this site was found; its Next.js bundle has no source map. That is why it stays at Level 2. Its bundled wallet kit, gateway.ensub.org, a news feed and a CORS proxy are connections, not third-party code.

connections.name: WalletConnect, Reown and Coinbase (api.web3modal.org, pulse, cca-lite)
connections.note: Configuration, fonts and telemetry requests from the site's own bundled wallet kit when the page opens.
